body:
| Concern | Pick | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Monorepo | pnpm workspaces | Lightweight, good peer-dep handling |
| Package build | tsup (or vite lib mode) | Fast ESM/CJS + types for publishable packages |
| Manifest | MV3 | Required for Chrome Web Store |
| Host app | React + TypeScript + Vite + CRXJS | Fast HMR, small bundle |
| Markdown / MDX | `@mdx-js/mdx` + `remark-gfm` + `rehype-katex` + Mermaid | JSX components in docs, powerful |
| Code highlight | Shiki | Shared across MD code blocks and (v0.2+) code viewer |
| JSON tree (v0.2+) | `react-json-view-lite` or custom virtualized tree | Handles big files |
| CSV (v0.2+) | Papaparse + TanStack Table | |
| Storage | IndexedDB via `idb-keyval` (Chrome host) | FS handles + metadata |
| Search | FlexSearch | Small, fast, local |
| Styling | Tailwind v4 + CSS vars | Theming cheap; CSS vars let packages be theme-agnostic |
